Workflow: Lattice embedding (parity-Kannan) -> LLL + BKZ-40 -> G6K GPU sieve (target saturation 0.425) -> scan of the short vectors -> randomized search over combinations of the short vectors (GPU int8 GEMM) -> exact check of Ax=d
Hardware Specifications: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (SXM, driver 580.126.20) + 32 threads of 2x Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ (Supermicro SYS-821GE-TNHR); CUDA 12.4.1, Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.10.12, fplll 5.4.1, fpylll 0.5.6, PyTorch 2.6.0, CuPy 14.2.0, G6K-GPU-Tensor (branch python3lwe, commit e0e17ad, 2022-01-10)
Remarks: 5 independent runs (seeds 3-7), all feasible; each run runs the sieve from scratch. Solved by the search over combinations of the short vectors. Runtime = wall clock incl. all stages, mean of 5 runs (min 26 s, max 31 s). Sieve reached target saturation in 5/5 runs. Distinct solutions: solution_0 from seed 3; solution_1 from seed 4; solution_2 from seed 5; solution_3 from seed 6; solution_4 from seed 7. CPU (32 threads) and GPU (1) are used concurrently throughout the run; CPU Runtime and GPU Runtime are the same wall-clock time, not busy time.
